open_obligations.what_is_open: Construction and proof of one fully observable, no-pretest common-multiplier interval \(\mathcal I_n^{\mathrm{mix}}\) with uniform coverage through the null, local, smoothness-critical, and regular regimes remain open.
open_obligations.obstruction: The established population-score, population-kernel Gaussian--quadratic proxy does not furnish observable spectral substitution, a common-multiplier coupling, or uniform anti-concentration at the corrected resolutions. In the admissible example \(d=1\), \(s_y=1/10\), and \(s_z=1\), the available sufficient covariance condition diverges rather than vanishes; this shows that the current controls do not prove the desired calibration, but it is not an impossibility theorem.
open_obligations.attempted: The population Gaussian--quadratic approximation was combined with the uniform second-order remainder envelope, and the available observed covariance and Hessian consistency conditions were checked at the corrected tuning. For \(d=0\), the exact null chaos was also compared with the required local-to-regular calibration, but it supplies neither the needed common-multiplier coupling nor uniform anti-concentration.
